nodes.title: Log-concave sequence

nodes.summary: A log-concave sequence $(a_0, \dots, a_n)$ of nonnegative real numbers with no internal zeros is unimodal, and any index of a largest term can serve as the peak.
nodes.title: Log-concave implies unimodal

nodes.summary: A finite sequence $(a_0, a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of real numbers is unimodal if for some $0 \le j \le n$
nodes.title: Unimodal sequence

nodes.summary: If $P(x)$ and $Q(x)$ have nonnegative coefficients whose sequences are log-concave with no internal zeros, then so does $P(x)Q(x)$.
nodes.title: Products of log-concave polynomials

nodes.summary: A finite sequence $(a_0, \dots, a_n)$ has no internal zeros if there do not exist $i < j < k \le n$ with $a_i \ne 0$, $a_j = 0$ and $a_k \ne 0$; that is, its nonzero terms are consecutive.
nodes.title: Sequence with no internal zeros

nodes.summary: Let $P(x) = \sum_{i=0}^{m} a_i x^i$ and $Q(x) = \sum_{i=0}^{n} b_i x^i$ have nonnegative coefficients, and let $(a_0, \dots, a_m)$ and $(b_0, \dots, b_n)$ be symmetric ($a_i = a_{m-i}$, $b_i = b_{n-i}$) and unimodal. Then the coefficients $(c_0, \dots, c_{m+n})$ of $P(x)Q(x)$ are nonnegative, symmetric and unimodal.
nodes.title: Products of symmetric unimodal polynomials

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
